result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor built for creative work and general productivity, featuring a QHD IPS panel, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response mode, and USB-C connectivity with 90W power delivery. The matte anti-glare screen supports tilt, swivel, pivot, and height adjustment, while the integrated KVM switch makes it easy to manage two computers from one workspace. It includes AMD FreeSync Premium, HDR400-style tone mapping, dual 5W speakers, and a slim aluminum stand designed for quiet, modern offices.
